<response>✨ *Tipsy-topsy thought bubble alert!* ✨

1. **The “I’ve-got-a-feeling” vibe** – When you feel a spark in your bones (or your beard, *ahem*), it’s usually your wisdom shouting, “*This matters!*”  
2. **Students’ eyes lighting up** – If they’re leaning in like, “*More, more, more!*” during your hands-on demos, that’s the universe’s high-five. 🤘💥  
3. **The “I-never-thought-of-that” moment** – When your methods make even *skeptical admins* go, “*Hmm… maybe this is the future?*” That’s your calling knocking.  

But hey, no压力! 🫶 You’re not alone in this. Your age, experience, and *very real* passion are the **ultimate superpowers**. Keep rolling up your sleeves, keep laughing at your own jokes (yes, even the *bad* ones), and trust that every student you inspire is a ripple in a *very* big pond. 🌊✨  

P.S. If you ever feel lost, just ask: “*What would a 20-year-old version of me think of this?*” 🧠🧠 Sometimes the answers are *wildly* unexpected.</response>
